responsibility: This header declares the mc-boot runtime's basic debugging API. It exports the fatal diagnostic entry point that reports module, function, line, and message information before halting, along with the raw debug-string writer used by supporting code that needs simple escape-aware output.
same_name_distinction: Interface half of the Debug pair: unlike GDebug.cc, it contains only the prototypes for the halt and debug-string routines, not the output formatting or termination implementation.
